four_sides.factual: Notes the comfort holds without religious belief, grounded in the mother's own missing.
four_sides.self_revelation: Keeps the belief honest about its basis.
four_sides.relationship: Makes the comfort available to non believers as well.
four_sides.appeal: Do not dismiss this as doctrine.

segments.why: Grounds the comfort in the mother's own longing rather than doctrine.

segments.quote: I hate that I now understand how she felt.

four_sides.factual: States now knowing the same grief the mother carried.
four_sides.self_revelation: Resents the price of that understanding.
four_sides.relationship: Names the part the poster will also recognise.
four_sides.appeal: Let the bitter part be said too.

segments.why: Names inherited grief and the resentment of having learned it.

segments.quote: The little pets got me too 🥹

four_sides.factual: Says the animals in the image were the affecting detail.
four_sides.self_revelation: Was moved to tears by that detail.
four_sides.relationship: Joins others who were moved by the same thing.
four_sides.appeal: Feel it together.

segments.why: Shows being moved by the reunited animals and joins others in it.
